_meta.blink_method: eye-band ROI per clip: |f - f-3| spikes, a revert test (f differs from f-4 and f+4 while those agree), and the iris/lash ink fraction (<70 grey); plus eye strips every 4 f read by eye. No clip closes an eye.
_meta.diff_note: d1 = mean |f - f-1| (grey, 1/4 res). The max at f128 in J2/J3/J4/O4/U3/U8 is an encoder grain refresh only: the blurred diff 127->128 is zero (checked on J2), no geometry moves.
_meta.camera_note: ORB similarity fit f0 -> every 3rd frame. J1/O1 readings are tissue motion, not camera (block / skull edges fixed). Real drift: U8 (scale 0.979-1.010, 18 px), J3 (1.8 %, 15 px, returns), O2b (9 px pan). All slow, no cuts.
